One database that three sources state, each given alone: by its name, by its name and its account, by its name and its native ID. The name joins the node of the account while that is the one node it fits (N3). The description with the native ID carries no account, so it is a second node. Then the first source is read again with the same content: the name now fits two nodes, and it stays with the node that it was taken as before (N4), which the records keep. Nothing is added and nothing leaves.
